meta.name: triage
meta.description: Move issues and external PRs through a state machine of triage roles — categorise, verify, grill if needed, and write agent-ready briefs.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把问题和外部提交有序分流，生成现成的任务简报
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你维护活跃的仓库，每天要处理大量问题和外部贡献的改动。
copy.tagline_en: Triage issues and external PRs in order, producing ready-to-use task briefs.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you maintain an active repository and deal with many issues and external contributions regularly.

howto.what: 装上后,当你用 /triage 提出需求,Claude 会按分诊流程处理 issue 和外部 PR:先归类为 bug 或改进,再设定状态(待处理、缺信息、可交AI、需人工、不修),展示需关注项,评论会带 AI 生成声明。
howto.when: 当你输入 /triage 命令并说明想处理什么时触发,例如“看看 #42”或“把 #42 移到 ready-for-agent”。

say.text: 用 /triage 看看有哪些 issue 需要我处理
say.note: 它会列出未标记、待分诊等需要关注的问题
它会直接应用状态,并询问是否要生成 agent 简报

say.text: 用 /triage 处理 #42,先给分类和状态建议
say.note: 它会先给出推荐,等你确认后再行动

howto.what_en: After installation, /triage makes Claude classify issues/PRs as bug or enhancement, assign one of five states, list what needs attention, and add an AI disclaimer to comments.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you enter /triage and describe what you want, e.g. "look at #42" or "move #42 to ready-for-agent".

say_en.text: Use /triage to see which issues need my attention
say_en.note: It lists unlabeled, needs-triage, and similar items
It applies the state and asks about writing an agent brief

say_en.text: Triage #42 and suggest a category and state first
say_en.note: It recommends first, then waits for your confirmation
